moves.comment: White takes the centre. You answer with ...c6, a solid move that prepares ...d5.

children.comment: This is the Caro-Kann. You get ...d5 next, with a safe king and no weak pawns.
White builds a big centre.
Hit the centre at once. Now White must decide what to do with the e4 pawn.
The Advance Variation. White gains space.
Bring the bishop out before ...e6 locks it in. This is the key Caro-Kann idea.
Now the bishop is outside your pawn chain. Close the centre and be solid.
Hit the centre. A pawn break like ...c5 is how you fight a space advantage.
Take the pawn. If they take back, you play on with an easy game.
Develop and get ready to castle. Aim at the e5 pawn and the d4 knight.
Hit the d4 knight. Now every piece fights for the centre.
Solid again. Keep the bishop outside.
They attack your bishop.
Retreat to the safe square. The bishop is still active.
Break in the centre. Attack the base of their pawn chain.
They offer a bishop trade.
Take it. Trade your good bishop for theirs and stay safe.
Solid. Next you play ...c5 to hit their centre.
A loose attack. It weakens their own king.
Just retreat. Pawns do not move back, so their weaknesses stay.
Stop h5. If they push on, ...Bh7 is a safe square.
They want to chase your bishop.
Stop their pawn. Your bishop stays safe.
The Exchange Variation. It is calm.
Retake with the c-pawn to keep the centre pawn on d5.
Develop and guard d5. Develop fast: knights before bishops.
Develop another piece. You hit e4 and control the centre.
Pin their knight and develop the bishop outside your pawns. Do it before ...e6.
They hit your b7 pawn and d5.
Guard b7 and keep d5 safe. Taking b7 would lose time and risk the queen.
Open your dark bishop and guard d5. You are solid.
Trade the bishop on f4 if you can. Then castle.
The Panov Attack. White hits d5.
Develop and guard d5 a second time. Your centre pawn is safe.
Solid. You can take on d5 or play ...Bb4.
Pin the knight on c3. It cannot guard d4 and e4 well now.
Take back with the knight. It is a strong centre square.
Develop. You hit d4 and keep control.
Retreat and develop. Next, castle.
